note: Which building produces which unit. Every unit in data/units.json appears exactly once (tests/gallery/production.test.js). art: game = drawn by src/render/buildings.js, concept = gallery/structure-art.js. origin: existing = already in the game, existing concept = drawn in the gallery before, new = invented for this page.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.blurb: Foot soldiers who need nothing but a bed and a rifle rack.

buildings.name: Agency
buildings.blurb: Dark-windowed office block. Spies and snipers work for it, not for the army.

buildings.name: Bunker
buildings.blurb: A hardened shelter that turns out the close-range specialists.

buildings.name: Training Ground
buildings.blurb: Drill yard with a target post: elite and melee troops.

buildings.name: Mech Factory
buildings.blurb: Tall bay with a crane: powered-armour infantry.

buildings.name: Aid Station
buildings.blurb: Red-cross hall with a canvas awning. The support infantry who keep the line alive.

buildings.name: Factory
buildings.blurb: The all-round vehicle hall, now for light and support wheels and the personnel carrier.

buildings.name: Supply Depot
buildings.blurb: Crates and a fuel drum: the trucks that feed the front line.

buildings.name: Heavy Factory
buildings.blurb: Squat hall under a slab roof with two stacks and a wide bay: the main battle tanks and big guns.

buildings.name: Rocket Factory
buildings.blurb: A hall beside a rack of rockets on end: everything that fires a rocket or a missile from the ground.

buildings.name: Hover Lab
buildings.blurb: Glass dome and a glowing pad: hover craft.

buildings.name: Stealth Lab
buildings.blurb: Dark faceted bunker with a single lit slit: everything that hides from radar.

buildings.name: Airfield
buildings.blurb: Runway, hangar and tower: the fixed-wing fighters and bombers.

buildings.name: Heliport
buildings.blurb: A painted pad with an H, a windsock and a hut: rotor craft.

buildings.name: Glider Field
buildings.blurb: A launch ramp and a windsock, for the lighter-than-air.

buildings.name: Radar Station
buildings.blurb: Mast and dish: the eyes in the sky.

buildings.name: Shipyard
buildings.blurb: Slipway and crane: the escorts and the working ships.

buildings.name: Harbor
buildings.blurb: A pier, a crane and a moored boat: small craft and the ships that put troops ashore.

buildings.name: Sub Pen
buildings.blurb: Hardened concrete shelter with a flooded mouth: every submarine.

buildings.name: Dry Dock
buildings.blurb: Gantry towers over a berth: the big hulls.

buildings.name: Underwater Lab
buildings.blurb: Two domes joined by a tube below the waterline: divers.

buildings.name: Engineer Works
buildings.blurb: Gear on the front and stacked wall blocks: the fixed defences and walls.

laid.note: Never bought: laid by a unit.
